run_whisper: run whisper speech-to-text inference with implicit and explicit encoder/decoder prompts
run_fireredasr2: run FireRedASR2 automatic speech recognition with implicit audio prompts
run_fireredlid: run FireRedLID language identification with explicit encoder/decoder prompts
parse_args: parse command-line arguments for model type and seed using FlexibleArgumentParser
main: run offline encoder-decoder multimodal inference with vLLM and print generated text
